skipProps.color: BOARD IS WRONG AND THE CODE DEVIATES ON PURPOSE (founder call 2026-09-08). Boards 151:12/151:17/151:38 name --color/ink-disabled #D1D5DB for the word 'required', which is 1.47:1 on white — under the 3:1 large-text floor and barely above invisible. The code followed them, so board and code AGREED and nothing failed; that is the one case where agreement is not evidence. A tag stating a field is MANDATORY is not decoration, and ink-disabled is the token for a control you cannot USE — WCAG exempts inactive controls precisely so they can be dim. Now --bk-ink-soft, 7.56:1. Size and line box are still joined and pass. The boards need the redraw; this join re-opens when they get it.
